prompt:
Bug: a recipe created by Import with AI from images has no cover image.

POST /api/recipes/create/ai with one or more images creates the recipe and writes the first image's files (GET /api/media/recipes/{recipe_id}/images/original.webp serves it), but the recipe does not record an image: GET /api/recipes/{slug} returns "image": null, so the recipe shows no cover.

Expected: when the AI import gets images, the created recipe's image field is set to a non-empty image key, as after an upload through PUT /api/recipes/{slug}/image, and original.webp is still served. Recipes created without images are unchanged.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/integration_tests/user_recipe_tests/test_recipe_create_from_ai.py` for quick loops; the whole backend suite is `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests` (about 8 minutes).
title: fix: set the cover image on recipes created from AI images (#8739)
